COVENANT (CVNT): transistors for vault chips, circuits meant to route an IGNIX token's trading tax (intended use; not enforced here). SUPPLY 67,108,864 (2^26), fixed; NAND and LATCH share the cap; burned transistors are never re-minted. PRICE 0.00002 OKB each, fixed. No per-wallet cap, no presale, no team allocation. PROCEEDS are split by an immutable contract with no owner: 85% keeper tank (prepays the settlement gas of the chips whose transistors paid in), 15% maintainer. TRUST (at creation): unaudited; TapeOut's owner can upgrade processor logic.
